nodes.title: Release 13 integration, the owner replay (a95d2ff1 on the packaged tree, TEST): with only the in-flight allowance, turn 23 shipped 'Screen par aloo ka picture dekhiye' and turn 3 'Screen par game' over the rules table (the board drawn for the request was the table again: 4A fix 1, unbuilt). Added: her line is re-checked against the board that actually arrived (the board-first ack, before prewarm) for the owner's two false-claim shapes only, and unpointed. Final packaged run: owner-5 14/14, round2-content 36/39, replay honest on every turn the owner flagged

Re-checking her line against the arrived board by word overlap: the board labels in its own words ('Solid / Liquid / Gas' while she says 'ice, paani, water vapour'), so 3 legitimate lines were unpointed in round2, and the shortened lines then failed their boards' W6 timing re-gate (2 boards)

Still open after release 13: on a turn that answers a visual request, a bare pointing line about a thing the board does not show ('Screen par potato dekhiye', no 'picture of' form) is not caught: the reply check stands aside for the piece in flight and the after-board check judges only the game and 'picture of X' shapes. Root fix: the board answers what the child asked for (4A r13 fix 1, RCA-1 todo)

md.rejected: - `rj-r13-word-overlap-after-board` (2026-10-11). Tried: judging her pointing line against the board that arrived, by overlap between her content words and the board's text. What broke: a board names things its own way ('Solid / Liquid / Gas' while she says 'ice, paani, water vapour'). Three legitimate lines in the packaged round2 run were unpointed, and two boards then failed the W6 timing re-gate because their lines got shorter after the board was timed to them. Instead: judge only the false-claim shapes the owner hit (a game over a board; a picture of a thing neither the board nor the kit has). Word overlap is not meaning.
